visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with an exterior shot of a traditional restaurant front named "阿湯哥" (Ah Tang Ge). Red lanterns hang from the eaves, and a white bicycle is parked in the foreground under bright natural daylight. (2) A medium shot shows the interior of the shop; a man in a black shirt sits at a wooden table near the entrance, looking out. (3) A close-up reveals a ladle pouring rich, dark broth into a red bowl filled with thick noodles, beef chunks, carrots, and green vegetables. (4) Multiple macro shots focus on the food: a pair of chopsticks lifts a thick, tender slice of beef, followed by a shot of wavy wide noodles being lifted. (5) A spoon adds a mixture of dried small fish and red chili peppers from a white bowl into the noodle soup, followed by a serving of green pickled vegetables. (6) A red plastic spoon scoops into a plate of shrimp and egg fried rice, showing clear, separate grains and plump shrimp. (7) The camera pans across a glass display shelf containing various small side dishes on red plates, including purple eggplant, golden fried tofu, and green broccoli. (8) A wide static shot captures the empty dining area with several sets of square wooden tables and stools under indoor lighting and a ceiling fan. (9) The video ends by returning to the exterior of the shop, showing the red sign and lanterns again as the camera tilts slightly upwards.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional food review for 'Ah Tang Ge Beef Noodles' in Kaohsiung. It aims to attract customers by highlighting the restaurant's long history (50 years), the high-quality ingredients used in its signature beef noodle soup, and the variety of complementary dishes like fried rice and unique side dishes. The friendly narration and close-up food shots are designed to evoke appetite and trust in the brand.
